contributions.summary: An ARIMA forecast of both prices is accurate enough to trade on.
Trading only on a clear trend keeps transaction costs from eating the return.
A two-objective search followed by a downside cut yields one daily portfolio.
The strategy is optimal because the forecast is close and the behavior is right in both regimes.
Lower transaction costs raise the five-year return, and the strategy still beats the disturbed copies.

dependency_graph.handoff: the forecast prices G_t and B_t
the market-state indicators M_t and N_t
the normal CVaR definition reused for the portfolio

assumptions.summary: No short selling of the volatile assets.
No borrowing, and the cash return is always zero.
Traders prefer the lower risk and the higher return when all else is equal.
The assets are infinitely divisible and the market information is open to everyone at once.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Ten missing gold prices fall on the holiday and are filled with the previous day.
The bitcoin range is far larger than the gold range.
The two prices move together and bitcoin moves more.

models.summary: The price is differenced once, the two orders are chosen by the smallest information criterion, and the residuals are checked for white noise before the forecast is used.
Ten moving averages judge the trend. The strict arrangement is stated, called rare, and replaced by a weaker rule, which then sets one indicator per asset.
Variance and beta are rejected for two stated reasons, the older tail measure is credited with two defects, and the conditional measure is adopted under a normal assumption.
Profit net of the two commissions and the portfolio tail risk form the two objectives. A search returns a feasible set, and the downside semi-variance at a fixed quantile picks one portfolio.

verification.summary: The forecast error is bounded with five indicators.
One rising window and one falling window are narrated.
Holdings are disturbed within a band and the strategy beats most copies.
The disturbance is rerun after the costs change.

results_trace.summary: The terminal value, the average year, and the best year.
The actual return against the simulated return, year by year.
The return at each stated cost pair.

weaknesses.summary: The variance is one over t-2 times the sum of (r_{i,k} - mu_{i,t}).
When both markets are active, y_t = y_t and z_t = z_t.
The downside semi-variance is V = W^T C^- W^T.
G_t is the forecast price of gold on day T.
The covariance is of the rate of return of asset i and the rate of return of asset i.
The five-year total return is 616.63 percent.
The last cost row is bitcoin at 3 percent and gold at 1.5 percent.
All rankings are in the top 10 percent.
The order p and q is the one that makes the criterion smallest.
The standard deviation of bitcoin ends at 15722.34.
The memo figure shows the Yield-CVAR model and the lower half variance.
The strategy beats 93 percent of the simulated strategies.

unresolved_questions: The winning lag orders are never printed.
The five-year total of 616.63 percent and the terminal dollar value are not reconciled.
Table 4's last row repeats an earlier row.
Table 5's ranks and the top-10-percent sentence disagree.
The memo's best year and worst year differ by 0.01 from the body.
